entities.name: Extended emergency number list
entities.description: An information element that may be sent by the network containing a list of emergency numbers with URN information, valid within the same country as the PLMN or only in the PLMN from which it is received.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that may send the extended emergency number list information element to the UE.

entities.name: Emergency numbers with URN information
entities.description: The contents of the extended emergency number list IE, representing emergency numbers along with their URN information.

entities.name: PLMN validity scope
entities.description: Condition specifying whether the emergency numbers are valid within the same country as the PLMN or only in the specific PLMN from which the IE is received.

relations.description: The network may send the extended emergency number list IE to the UE.
The extended emergency number list IE contains emergency numbers with URN information.
The validity scope of the emergency numbers is guarded by the PLMN from which the IE is received.
